label: Phase 2 upgrade frontend api.ts with notifications, print, and record adjustment helpers
instruction: Update client/src/modules/leave_elm/api.ts to keep existing exports (LeaveApplication, LeaveBalance, LeaveTask, LeaveHistory, LeaveNotification, Configuration, NewApplication, listApplications, listBalances, listTasks, submitApplication, applicationAction, getConfiguration, saveConfiguration, getRecords) while expanding NewApplication to allow leave_type: string | number and optional station_leave_required, address_during_leave, contact_number, academic_substitute_user_id, admin_substitute_user_id, attachment_reference, and adding listNotifications(): Promise<LeaveNotification[]> (GET '/leave/notifications') and adjustBalanceRecord(payload: Record<string, unknown>) (POST '/leave/records'). In applicationAction(id, action, data={}), post `{ action, ...data, data }` to `/leave/applications/${id}/action`. Return only valid TypeScript code.
